breaking: Rendered as <a href> instead of <button>; click no longer calls window.scrollTo, the browser follows href (default #top) and the URL gets the hash
Click ripple and bounce animations removed; hover/active scale stays
ScrollToTopProgress aria-label no longer includes the scrolled percentage
The button follows the nearest scroller (scroll(nearest)), not only the window
behavior="smooth" sets html scroll-behavior: smooth via :has() while the link is hovered, pressed or focused
New optional props: label (all variants), href
useScrollToTop is kept only for client code (components/docs/docs-page-nav.tsx imports it); the components no longer use it

how.en: Link to #top, scroll(nearest) timeline for showing and the ring
how.ru: Ссылка на #top, шкала scroll() для появления и кольца
